packages.name: Reclaim
packages.notes:
0.1.1-1573
- Titled dialogs use DSM's 3px corners and stay within the DSM window.
- Two messages that showed as raw keys now have text in every language.
- Built on SDK 0.12.2 and UI 0.10.3; no new approval is needed after the upgrade from 0.1.1-1572.

packages.name: Connect
packages.notes:
0.1.0-0054
- Dialogs take DSM's widths and corners and stay inside the Connect window.
- Page titles are followed by the same spacing as DSM's, instead of a double gap.
- Opening Connect again from the DSM main menu while it is open rechecks the connections.
- Upgrading from 0.1.0-0053 needs no administrator approval.

packages.name: Download Hub
packages.notes:
0.2.2-0039
- New download is as wide as DSM's own dialogs with a text box (530 px), so long links wrap less; dialogs with a title have DSM's 3 px corners.
- Dialogs stay inside a narrow DSM window and fill the width on a phone.
- The buttons on Core updates are DSM's pill-shaped action buttons.
- Upgrading from 0.2.2-0038 needs no administrator approval.
